links.outcome: AUC on external cohorts before and after adjusting model weights with local subset
links.effect: Baseline AUC 0.55 (test-set-2) and 0.63 (test-set-3); after adjusting weights with 40 local patients, AUC improved to 0.65 and 0.70.
links.quote: After adjusting CT and RD weights of the model using a subset of the RTOG-0617 subjects, the discriminatory power of test-set-2 and 3 improved to AUC 0.65 and AUC 0.70, respectively.

links.outcome: Discrimination of baseline model on external validation cohorts versus internal prospective test set
links.effect: Baseline AUC 0.83 for test-set-1, but 0.55 for test-set-2 and 0.63 for test-set-3 in external RTOG 0617 cohorts.
links.quote: The discriminative ability of a baseline trained model had an AUC of 0.83 for test-set-1, 0.55 for test-set-2, and 0.63 for test-set-3.
